lines.text: David swore to the Mighty One of Jacob that he would not enter his house until he found a place for the LORD.
The people heard the ark was in Bethel, found it in the fields of Jaar, and invited each other to worship.
The LORD swore to David that one of his descendants would sit on his throne, and his sons' sons too if they kept the covenant.
The LORD chose Zion as His home forever and promised to satisfy her poor with oil.
The LORD will clothe Zion's priests with salvation, prepare a lamp for His anointed one, and clothe his enemies with shame.
